scope: SUMMARY.50 selector purpose, concise answer notes and explicit canonical four-metric financial context; existing safe immutable one-catalog rollout.
checks: Exact diff changes only SUMMARY.50 version (1 to 2), purpose, notes and calculation_contract. Other templates and all existing dependencies, metrics, input policies, workflows, API schema/requests and source bindings are unchanged.
Purpose explicitly covers the four existing supported metrics and interprets before/after as the start/end of the requested period, not an arbitrary event or the current account balance.

Actual canonical source expressions match the direct amount/currency paths total.opening_balance, total.closing_balance and total.accrued. Payments match sum_values of total.payments[].value with each currency_code checked.

All four canonical registry definitions use currency units, signed values and financial_period semantics. Contract forbids sign inversion, absolute value, reconstruction from selected components or current-balance substitution.
Empty payments yield zero only for a complete verified report. Missing fields or an incomplete document are not zeros, and one unavailable measure must remain visibly unknown rather than disappear.
Notes request all explicitly requested values with the four appropriate labels and number words; no unconditional restriction suppresses additional explicitly requested measures.
Independent canonical path/currency extraction, unit/sign/time-axis checks, unchanged dependency order, exact scope, patch consistency, validate_catalog and Python compilation pass.

Installer delta from approved Ozon fee installer is limited to release identity, immutable pins and metadata. Only template_catalog.json may differ, preserving safe hardlinks, changed-inode replacement, atomic manifest, full base hashes, no-active-jobs guard, native preflight, process cwd verification, config equality and rollback.

verification.independent_local: Exact scope; all four actual canonical field/currency expressions; currency/signed/financial_period definitions; dependency order; patch; validate_catalog; compile PASS.
verification.server_suite: Fresh complete 107-test run required by installer gate; server result not independently observed at review time.

limitations: Selector support recognition and final four-value answer require the planned exact-question live acceptance retest; metadata correctness alone does not guarantee model selection.
Unchanged hardlinked release payloads must remain immutable; later changes must replace destination inodes.
